title: 3EN002 large security hardening
description: Large coherent hardening change for OpenWrt 3EN002 with router-side backup and rollback. Disables SSH password/root-password authentication while preserving the tested SSH key, restricts LuCI/uHTTPd listeners to LAN IPv4 192.168.1.2, enables HTTP-to-HTTPS redirect, and persists safer redirect/rp_filter sysctl settings. Firewall, banIP, DHCP and DNS configuration are intentionally left unchanged. Post-change validation checks SSH key access, LuCI HTTPS, router/Pi-hole reachability, DNS resolution and Internet reachability.
backup:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $HostIp='192.168.1.2'; $User='root'; $Key=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.ssh\3en002_agent_ed25519'; $ssh=(Get-Command ssh.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source; $remote=@'
set -e
B=/root/3en-backup-013
rm -rf "$B"
mkdir -p "$B"
cp -p /etc/config/dropbear "$B/dropbear"
cp -p /etc/config/uhttpd "$B/uhttpd"
if [ -f /etc/sysctl.d/99-3en-hardening.conf ]; then cp -p /etc/sysctl.d/99-3en-hardening.conf "$B/99-3en-hardening.conf"; echo present > "$B/sysctl.marker"; else echo absent > "$B/sysctl.marker"; fi
uci show dropbear > "$B/dropbear.before.txt"
uci show uhttpd > "$B/uhttpd.before.txt"
sysctl net.ipv4.conf.all.rp_filter net.ipv4.conf.default.rp_filter net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.all.send_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.send_redirects net.ipv6.conf.all.accept_redirects > "$B/sysctl.before.txt" 2>&1 || true
echo BACKUP_013_OK
'@; $remote | & $ssh -i $Key -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 ($User+'@'+$HostIp) 'sh -s' 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ }; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw '013 backup failed'}
script:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $HostIp='192.168.1.2'; $User='root'; $Key=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.ssh\3en002_agent_ed25519'; $ssh=(Get-Command ssh.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source; Write-Host '=== APPLY 3EN002 HARDENING 013 ==='; $remote=@'
set -e
[ -f /root/3en-backup-013/dropbear ] || { echo BACKUP_MISSING; exit 21; }
[ -s /etc/dropbear/authorized_keys ] || { echo AUTHORIZED_KEYS_MISSING; exit 22; }

echo '--- SSH HARDENING ---'
uci set dropbear.main.PasswordAuth='off'
uci set dropbear.main.RootPasswordAuth='off'
uci commit dropbear

echo '--- LUCI/UHTTPD HARDENING ---'
uci -q delete uhttpd.main.listen_http
uci -q delete uhttpd.main.listen_https
uci add_list uhttpd.main.listen_http='192.168.1.2:80'
uci add_list uhttpd.main.listen_https='192.168.1.2:443'
uci set uhttpd.main.redirect_https='1'
uci commit uhttpd

echo '--- SYSCTL HARDENING ---'
mkdir -p /etc/sysctl.d
cat > /etc/sysctl.d/99-3en-hardening.conf <<'EOF'
net.ipv4.conf.all.rp_filter=1
net.ipv4.conf.default.rp_filter=1
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects=0
net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects=0
net.ipv4.conf.all.send_redirects=0
net.ipv4.conf.default.send_redirects=0
net.ipv6.conf.all.accept_redirects=0
net.ipv6.conf.default.accept_redirects=0
EOF
sysctl -p /etc/sysctl.d/99-3en-hardening.conf

echo '--- RESTART SERVICES ---'
/etc/init.d/uhttpd restart
/etc/init.d/dropbear restart
sleep 2

echo '--- POST STATE ---'
uci show dropbear
uci show uhttpd | grep -E 'listen_http|listen_https|redirect_https'
sysctl net.ipv4.conf.all.rp_filter net.ipv4.conf.default.rp_filter net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.all.send_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.send_redirects net.ipv6.conf.all.accept_redirects net.ipv6.conf.default.accept_redirects
netstat -lntp 2>/dev/null | grep -E ':(22|80|443) ' || true
echo HARDENING_013_APPLY_OK
'@; $remote | & $ssh -i $Key -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 ($User+'@'+$HostIp) 'sh -s' 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ }; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw '013 apply failed'}
test: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $HostIp='192.168.1.2'; $Key=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.ssh\3en002_agent_ed25519'; $ssh=(Get-Command ssh.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source; Write-Host '=== VALIDATE HARDENING 013 ==='; $out=& $ssh -i $Key -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 root@192.168.1.2 "echo SSH_KEY_OK; uci get dropbear.main.PasswordAuth; uci get dropbear.main.RootPasswordAuth; uci get uhttpd.main.redirect_https" 2>&1; $out | ForEach-Object {Write-Host $_}; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or ($out -notcontains 'SSH_KEY_OK')){throw 'SSH key validation failed'}; if(($out -notcontains 'off') -or ($out -notcontains '1')){throw 'Hardening state validation failed'}; $t443=Test-NetConnection -ComputerName 192.168.1.2 -Port 443 -WarningAction SilentlyContinue; if(-not $t443.TcpTestSucceeded){throw 'LuCI HTTPS 443 unavailable'}; $t80=Test-NetConnection -ComputerName 192.168.1.2 -Port 80 -WarningAction SilentlyContinue; if(-not $t80.TcpTestSucceeded){throw 'LuCI HTTP redirect listener 80 unavailable'}; if(-not(Test-Connection 192.168.1.3 -Count 1 -Quiet)){throw 'Pi-hole unreachable'}; $dns=Resolve-DnsName google.com -Type A -DnsOnly -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object {$_.IPAddress} | Select-Object -First 1; if(-not $dns){throw 'DNS resolution failed'}; if(-not(Test-Connection 8.8.8.8 -Count 1 -Quiet)){throw 'Internet ICMP validation failed'}; Write-Host 'VALIDATION_013=PASS'
rollback:
$ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; $HostIp='192.168.1.2'; $Key=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.ssh\3en002_agent_ed25519'; $ssh=(Get-Command ssh.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source; if(-not $ssh){Write-Host 'ROLLBACK ERROR: ssh.exe missing'; return}; $remote=@'
B=/root/3en-backup-013
if [ ! -f "$B/dropbear" ] || [ ! -f "$B/uhttpd" ]; then echo ROLLBACK_BACKUP_MISSING; exit 31; fi
cp -f "$B/dropbear" /etc/config/dropbear
cp -f "$B/uhttpd" /etc/config/uhttpd
if [ "$(cat "$B/sysctl.marker" 2>/dev/null)" = present ]; then cp -f "$B/99-3en-hardening.conf" /etc/sysctl.d/99-3en-hardening.conf; sysctl -p /etc/sysctl.d/99-3en-hardening.conf >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; else rm -f /etc/sysctl.d/99-3en-hardening.conf; fi
/etc/init.d/uhttpd restart
/etc/init.d/dropbear restart
echo ROLLBACK_013_OK
'@; $remote | & $ssh -i $Key -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 root@192.168.1.2 'sh -s' 2>&1 | ForEach-Object {Write-Host $_}; Write-Host ('ROLLBACK_SSH_EXIT='+$LASTEXITCODE)
